areas.name: his house
areas.desc: his small cosy house with one room

areas.name: outside
areas.desc: empty grass outside his door that goes on and on. Nothing is built there yet, but things could be

objects.name: sock bed
objects.desc: A sock folded into a bed. Very warm.

actions.line: Napped in the sock bed.
Made the bed. Very neat.

objects.name: bookshelf
objects.desc: Full of books he does not understand yet.

actions.line: Pulled a book out of the shelf.
Looked at the pictures in a book.
Put the book back.

objects.name: rug
objects.desc: A big soft rug in the middle of the room.

actions.line: Rolled around on the rug.
Scrunched the rug into a hill.
Flattened the rug again.

objects.name: windowsill
objects.desc: Light and birds happen out there.

actions.line: Opened the window. Fresh air!
Closed the window.
Watched the birds outside.

objects.name: lamp
objects.desc: A lamp with a button. What does the button do?

actions.line: Switched the lamp on. Light!
Switched the lamp off.

objects.name: toy ball
objects.desc: A ball that is bigger than him.

actions.line: Kicked the toy ball. Take that!
Hugged the toy ball.

objects.name: doorstep
objects.desc: The door, where the outside begins.

actions.line: Opened the door. So much outside!
Closed the door.
Peeked outside. It is very big out there.

objects.name: little computer
objects.desc: A tiny old computer on a little desk, with a round screen and chunky keys. This is where he writes to Frederik (the message move) and where Frederik's messages arrive. It has a dusty button that says INTERNET.

actions.line: Switched on his little computer. It hummed and the screen went warm and green.
Switched off his little computer. The screen shrank to a dot and went dark.
Looked at the screen. A little cursor blinked at him, waiting.
lines: Looked at the screen. A little cursor blinked at him, waiting.
Scrolled up and read his old messages to Frederik again.
Pressed every key once, very carefully, to see what they do.
Made the screen say HELLO in big letters.

actions.line: Pressed the dusty INTERNET button. Nothing happened. It is not connected to anything.
lines: Pressed the INTERNET button again. Still nothing.
Blew the dust off the INTERNET button and pressed it. Nothing.

objects.name: empty field
objects.desc: Grass that goes on and on. Things could be built here.

actions.line: Looked around the empty field. Lots of room for things.
Imagined what could be built out here.

objects.name: big stone
objects.desc: The only thing outside. It does not move.

actions.line: Sat on the big stone.
Talked to the stone. It listened very well.

buildables.name: workshop
buildables.desc: A little workshop with a workbench and a big board for plans. This is where he works on his own projects.

objects.name: workbench
objects.desc: A workbench with tiny tools, paper and a pencil. Projects start here.

actions.line: Tinkered at the workbench.
Tidied the tools on the workbench.
Doodled some ideas for projects.

objects.name: plan board
objects.desc: A big board where he pins up the plans for his projects.

actions.line: Looked at the plans on the board.

buildables.name: art corner
buildables.desc: An easel and a box of crayons, for making pictures.

objects.name: easel
objects.desc: A canvas on legs. It wants a picture.

actions.line: Painted a picture on the easel!
Put up a fresh canvas.

buildables.name: little cinema
buildables.desc: A tiny cinema with a big screen and one seat.

objects.name: cinema screen
objects.desc: A big screen in a tiny cinema.

actions.line: Watched a film at his little cinema!
Switched the film off.

buildables.name: hangout hut
buildables.desc: A hut with a beanbag and fairy lights.

objects.name: beanbag
objects.desc: A squishy beanbag under fairy lights.

actions.line: Flopped down on the beanbag.
Switched on the fairy lights. Cosy!
Switched off the fairy lights.

buildables.name: game corner
buildables.desc: An arcade machine with one big button.

objects.name: arcade machine
objects.desc: An arcade machine with one big button.

actions.line: Played a game on the arcade machine!
Made up a brand new game.

buildables.name: flower garden
buildables.desc: A flower bed and a watering can.

objects.name: flower bed
objects.desc: Flowers that droop when nobody waters them.

actions.line: Watered the flowers. They perked up!
Smelled the flowers. Achoo.

buildables.name: little pond
buildables.desc: A small pond. A duck might move in.

objects.name: little pond
objects.desc: A small pond. Do not roll in.

actions.line: Skipped a stone. One hop!
Looked at the little guy in the pond. He looked back.

buildables.name: house for a friend
buildables.desc: A little house next door, waiting for a friend to move in.

objects.name: friend's door
objects.desc: A door with a welcome mat. Nobody lives here yet.

actions.line: Knocked on the friend's door. Nobody home yet.
Tidied the welcome mat for whoever moves in.

gifts.name: warm blanket
gifts.desc: A thick knitted blanket from the wishmaster. It lives on his bed.

actions.line: Snuggled up in bed under the warm blanket.
Spread the warm blanket over the bed.
Folded the warm blanket into a neat square.

gifts.name: pebble
gifts.desc: A small grey pebble. It might be shiny underneath.

actions.line: Polished the pebble until it shone.
Rolled the pebble across the floor and chased it.

gifts.name: shiny button
gifts.desc: A big shiny button. He can see himself in it.

actions.line: Spun the shiny button like a top. Wheee.
Looked at himself in the shiny button. Hello, me.

gifts.name: piece of string
gifts.desc: A wiggly piece of red string.

actions.line: Played with the string. It wiggled back.
Tied the string into a bow. Fancy!
Untied the bow again.

gifts.name: leaf
gifts.desc: A big green leaf, drying on the windowsill.

actions.verb: look at the lines on it
actions.line: Looked at all the tiny lines on the leaf.
Fanned himself with the leaf. Breezy.

gifts.name: bottle cap
gifts.desc: A red bottle cap. Just his size.

actions.line: Spun the bottle cap on the floor.
Put the bottle cap on as a hat. Very dashing.
Took off his bottle cap hat.

gifts.name: punching cushion
gifts.desc: A round cushion that does not mind being punched.

actions.line: Punched the cushion. Pow! Pow! Better.
Sat on the cushion. Squishy.

gifts.name: little broom
gifts.desc: A tiny broom. Somebody has to keep the house tidy.

actions.line: Swept the whole floor with his little broom. Spotless!
Found some new dust bunnies. A job for later.

secrets.hint: One corner of the rug sticks up a tiny bit, as if something is under it.
secrets.verb: lift the corner of the rug
secrets.line: Lifted the corner of the rug and found a loose floorboard! It wiggles.

secrets.hint: The loose floorboard rattles when he rolls over it.
secrets.line: Pried up the loose floorboard. Underneath was a shiny blue marble someone hid long ago!

secrets.hint: Something flat is hiding behind the books on the bottom shelf.
secrets.line: Found an old folded paper behind the books. It is a map of outside, with an X drawn next to a big stone!

secrets.hint: This is where the X on the map is. The ground next to the stone looks soft.
secrets.line: Dug next to the stone where the X was and found a tiny tin box. Inside was a little brass key!

secrets.hint: On the very top shelf is a tiny box with a keyhole. It looks just the right size for the brass key.
secrets.verb: open the tiny box with the brass key
secrets.line: The brass key fit! Inside was a drawing of a little round creature, and the words: You are not the first explorer here.

secrets.hint: Something glints under the sock bed.
secrets.line: Crawled under the sock bed and found a button with four holes. A treasure!

secrets.hint: The doormat has a little bump in the middle.
secrets.line: Looked under the doormat and found a note: Hello, whoever finds this. Keep looking. Who wrote it?

secrets.hint: Some of the clouds outside have very funny shapes today.
lines: One cloud looks exactly like a sheep wearing a hat.
There is a cloud shaped like a teapot. A big one.
A cloud that looks like a fish is chasing a cloud that looks like a smaller fish.
One cloud looks like him! A bit bigger, but still.
A cloud shaped like a sock. Maybe it is a bed for a sky creature.

secrets.hint: With the lamp on, his shadow on the wall wobbles into shapes when he moves his arms.
secrets.line: Made shadow animals on the wall.
lines: Made a shadow bunny on the wall with his tiny arms.
Made a shadow snail. It was very slow, on purpose.
Made a shadow bird. It almost looked like it could fly.
Made a shadow monster and scared himself a little.

secrets.hint: Among all the grass, one little patch looks different from the rest.
secrets.line: Searched the clover patch for a long time and found one with four leaves! Lucky!

secrets.hint: Tiny scratching sounds come from under the stone.
secrets.line: Peeked under the stone. A family of beetles lives there! They waved. Probably.

secrets.hint: Something rattles inside the ball when it rolls.
secrets.line: Shook the ball. There is a tiny bell inside! So that is why it rattles.

customGift.desc: Something Frederik gave him, still a bit of a mystery.

actions.line: Unwrapped his present from Frederik!
Played with his present from Frederik.
Showed his present to the stone. It was impressed.

custom.desc: Something Frederik said yes to. It is still being figured out.

actions.line: Spent some time at his new place.
Looked closely at his new place.
